text: Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing how we work. One of the most obvious effects is automation, where machines take over repetitive tasks like data entry or scheduling. This frees up employees to focus on more creative and strategic work. Beyond automation, AI-powered productivity tools, such as smart email filters and virtual assistants, help people manage their time and complete projects faster. However, this doesn't mean humans are being replaced. The real value lies in human-AI collaboration, where people use AI to make better decisions, while AI relies on human judgment for complex situations. Of course, job changes are inevitable. Some roles will disappear, but new ones—like AI trainers and ethics specialists—will emerge, requiring workers to adapt and learn new skills.
